task: Let MCP-Connect deliver link-only MCP file results by resolving strict file:/// resource_link items in opted-in stdio tool results through the existing MR !314 export reading code, replacing each link with an embedded file or a refusal note under the shared per-call budget.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is explicit export in client/export.py (_check_path, _collect_into, budget). It does not cover the new security-sensitive aspect: link paths come from the MCP server's output rather than the model's arguments, and need percent-decoding that _check_path never does (decoded %2f, %00, %2e%2e must be caught). Pydantic AnyUrl may already normalise the URI before apply sees it, so strictness is unverified. In-place replacement conflicts with spec criterion 10 (server content byte-identical). Acceptance criteria enumerate edge/refusal cases (refused link, invalid UTF-8, shared budget, dedupe) with no existing ResourceLink fixture. Rollback is easy (opt-in switch, single module).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk set to L: security-sensitive file read from server-named paths, URI decoding not covered by the existing path guard (divergence bump)
Edge-case AC with no existing ResourceLink test template: Technical Risk kept at L
